theme: CS5-2 tuple sub-patterns bound against their element
text: CHECKER (infer.rs, all engines): a Some/Ok/Err/struct/nested sub-pattern of a tuple pattern on a known subject is bound against its resolved element, so a misused payload such as (Some(a), b) on (Some("x"), 2) with a + 1 is E0102 instead of a run panic; an element still unresolved at bind time stays unbound. New refusals of programs that run: a sub-pattern that cannot match its element (Some(a) on an i64 or str element, a dead arm; D4). No interpreter or runtime change. The 717 tracked .ax files check with the same exit codes and diagnostics as the base binary.
